info.name: Kong Enterprise Admin ACLs Catalog Service API Mappings API
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.0 spec for Kong Gateway's Admin API.

You can learn more about Kong Gateway at [developer.konghq.com](https://developer.konghq.com).
Give Kong a star at the [Kong/kong](https://github.com/kong/kong) repository.

Contact Support:
 Name: Kong Inc
 Email: support@konghq.com

item.name: List Service Mappings for an API

query.description: The maximum number of items to include per page. The last page of a collection may include fewer items.
Determines which page of the entities to retrieve.

Sorts a collection of catalog service API mappings. Supported sort attributes are:


  - `created_at`
  - `updated_at`

Default sort is `created_at` in descending order.

Filters a collection of catalog API service mappings for a given API. Supported filter attributes are:


  - `service_id`

Filters a collection of catalog API service mappings for a given API. Supported filter attributes are:


  - `service_id`

Filters a collection of catalog API service mappings for a given API. Supported filter attributes are:


  - `service_id`

request.description: Returns a paginated collection of Service mappings for the given API.

response.name: A paginated list response for a collection of catalog service API mappings.
